notes.title: Fire Support - Major Update is Live
notes.notes:
[h1]Major Update: Fire Support [/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341641/a675b29bcb1698712465666521c00f4f94970d0c.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Agents!! We’ve got a Big One for you today with the Neon Abyss 2 Fire Support update, our first major patch since Early Access release. We’ve got a couple of brand new elements added here, as well as a huge number of fixes and balances for a bunch of weapons.[/p][p]The Fire Support patch is live NOW, after testing in our Beta Branch over the weekend. The highlights include:[/p][list][*][p][b]The New Blackdog Patch System[/b] – allowing players to pick a starter build to jump in with, following failure in the Abyss[/p][/*][*][p][b]Weapon Fixes and Balancing[/b] – we’ve been listening to your feedback and have a huge list of weapon tweaks and fixes[/p][/*][*][p][b]Visual optimisation and improvements [/b]– for multiple visual effects and artwork[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Items[/b]! – adding a little more spice to the Abyss[/p][/*][/list][p]If you played back at launch, there’s a whole lot more to jump in with now, as well as ongoing fixes and improvements (it’s Early Access, right?!). Let us know how you find the new Fire Support patch and we’ll continue to throw tweaks, fixes, improvements and balancing at you in the coming weeks before our NEXT Major Update.[/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]The Blackdog Patch System[/b][/h3][p]This all-new system lends a hand to players after a losing run in the Abyss (and we know there are a few of you out there! Sadly, me included). This new ability can be unlocked within the first page of the Evolution Tree, allowing a little leg up for those that fancy it. After losing a run, players will be thrown a random weapon / item bundle, specially bolted together by our Abyss Architects.[/p][p]Agents who complete an Abyss run with their random item bundle from the Blackdog Patch will unlock it to be able to select in future – meaning that you can choose to select that again (after failure in the Abyss), or get another random Patch to try out a new combination and try and unlock that one, too.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341641/d29d1cfa15c76957aa22db0f1050372fb6ee2f60.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341641/fad2d341a0a7b585d759ac7ab7339fa1eb33d50d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Comprehensive Weapon Adjustment, Optimisation and Balancing[/b][/h3][p]We’ve been listening to your feedback, and one of the things you’ve really let us know about is that weapon balancing has been feeling a little off in the Abyss. We’ve been taking some time to add a butt-load of new tweaks (and fixes) for a huge number of weapons.[/p][p]All of these changes are in addition to our new Damage system. While we’re not giving you the ins and outs on exactly how this works (we need to keep SOME things aloof and mysterious) we’re hoping that this will help with weapon balancing, and all weapons have had stats tweaked to essentially improve the fun factor – though we’ll let you be the judges of that.[/p][p]We’ve put a (partial!) list of these within the more patch-notes style bit just below, but do also keep in mind that the team are constantly working on weapon tweaks and balancing within regular updates. Your feedback is not only welcome, but critical to these balancing patches, as we need to know what you like and don’t like. We can’t promise to make every tweak (as one Agent’s Abyss Trash is another Agent’s Abyss Tresure) but we’re using feedback heavily to plan and prioritise balancing.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341641/cd45f6bf2d83a319a9bebc6f36e2cabdfdcd31da.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Visual Optimisations and Additions.[/b][/h3][p]The Abyss is meant to be chaotic, that’s the point of the Abyss, and it only gets crazier with multiplayer co-op. But we’ve heard your feedback, and we do agree that it needs to be manageable chaos at the very least (for reference, see the weird scene with Jeff Goldblum in the original Jurassic Park movie where he’s dropping water on Laura Dern’s hand).[/p][p]So we’ve been making changes to how the chaos gets represented in game. We’ve toned down player effect animations, and increased visibility of enemy projectiles as well. All of this aims to keep the chaotic feeling of the Abyss, while making sure you can see what you’re doing and what’s going on around you.[/p][p]We’ve also added new high-definition pixel art for all weapons , just to help the Abyss get a little extra shine.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New exciting Items[/b][/h3][p]After searching the forums, it looks like you all really wanted new items which helped you to get more jump boxes, so we’ve added 94 new items to help you get additional jumps![/p][p]I really need to point out that this is a joke, just for anybody who thinks we’re being serious. We’ve not added jump boxes, but we HAVE added a bunch of new items which improve attack speed, range and trajectory aiming, which we hope to help you feel a bit more buffed up in the Abyss.[/p][p]Seriously, though. If you do want more jump boxes, just say. We’ve got so many going spare and we can just throw them into the Abyss any time.[/p][h2]
The (Blackdog) Patch notes[/h2][p]So. That’s the narrative. But if you’re the type of Nerd that likes a bullet point list, we’ve got your back. Here it is in all it’s stunning glory. The Patch Notes for our first major patch, the Fire Support Update.[/p][h3][b]Additions[/b][/h3][list][*][p]New Blackdog Patch Mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]New Damage System[/p][/*][*][p]New items[/p][/*][/list][h3]Weapon Adjustment List (partial)[/h3][list][*][p][b]VOLTEDGE[/b] - Mechanic Change: Charge time no longer decreases continuously, but each slash's damage increases progressively.[/p][/*][*][p][b]VAJRA[/b] - Greatly reduced guardian cooldown. Guardian attack range scales with damage growth. New mechanic: Landing normal attacks during cooldown reduces cooldown time.[/p][/*][*][p][b]RAGNAROK[/b] - Optimised charge time and reduced axe recall difficulty. Increased flame gauntlet attack speed and damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]AVALANCHE[/b] - Fixed a bug causing double damage (sorry!) and reduced weapon charge time.[/p][/*][*][p][b]OBLIVION[/b] - Reduced charge time and added piercing effect.[/p][/*][*][p][b]CATALYST[/b] - New mechanic: Enemies marked beyond 9 layers detonate immediately.[/p][/*][*][p][b]COGDRIVE[/b] - Greatly reduced all charge times. Fixed a bug where damage could be taken during third-stage dash attacks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]WILDSHIFT[/b] - Fixed a bug where weapon damage wasn't affected by egg count. Significantly increased mark duration.[/p][/*][*][p][b]RED WIDOW[/b] - New mechanic: More eggs extend the reload window.[/p][/*][*][p][b]LOONG[/b] - Optimized dragon behaviour for better player control.[/p][/*][*][p][b]JADEWEAVE[/b] - Optimised orb behaviour and fixed orbs not attacking enemies (because, honestly, what’s the point if they don’t).[/p][/*][*][p][b]ZANSHIN[/b] - Fixed a bug where damage could be taken during dash attacks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]FLUORESCENT[/b] - Increased weapon damage and attack speed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]JINGU BANG[/b] - Fixed a bug where spell damage didn't scale. Increased staff swing range.[/p][/*][*][p][b]PULSEARC[/b] - Fixed missing damage bug. Optimised lightning strike mechanics and fixed tracking logic errors.[/p][/*][*][p][b]EUPHONY[/b] - Greatly increased soundwave range and weapon attack speed. Removed combo mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NIRVANA[/b] - Mechanic optimization: Not attacking no longer interrupts combos. Greatly increased soundwave range and damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]SWEETALK[/b] - Weapon attacks changed to soft lasers. Super Hatchmons now generate additional homing bullets.[/p][/*][*][p][b]TOPSPIN[/b] - Fixed a bug where tennis balls could disappear (new balls, please!)[/p][/*][*][p][b]YOKO[/b] - Increased Hatchmon absorption speed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]SUNDER[/b] - Adjusted to key-themed weapon. Fixed critical-hit chance bug.[/p][/*][*][p][b]ASCEND[/b] - Increased Wisp absorption speed and spirit sword damage/flight speed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]PURGE[/b] - Fixed a bug where homing bullets couldn't deal multi-hit damage. Increased Wisp absorption speed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]CACKLE[/b] - Increased sound ring speed damage, and Wisp absorption speed. Sound rings no longer trigger "Popcorn" explosions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]VERDICT[/b] - Increased weapon range. Optimised light spear logic to prevent missed targets.[/p][/*][*][p][b]TEMPEST[/b] - Increased storm cloud movement speed. Fixed a bug where bullets hitting clouds generated marks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]STEEL TEETH[/b] - tack speed bonuses now extend sawblade duration.[/p][/*][*][p][b]CHAMPION[/b] - New mechanic: More jump marks reduce Frenzy loss when hurt.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Optimisations and Adjustments[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]XUAN[/b]'s skill now grants invincibility frames.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fishing Room[/b] and [b]Zen Room[/b] no longer display as Arcade Room icons (ever visited a Zen Arcade room?).[/p][/*][*][p][b]GOD OF ENTERTAINMENT (HYPERION)[/b] Phase 2 superheroes now appear in random order, much like sound balancing on entertainment streaming services.[/p][/*][*][p]Task system now displays progress for clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced plugin display time and boss transformation duration for better pacing.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed weapon raise state persisting after upgrading in Soul Room.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed potential errors when generating relics.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed errors when collecting [b]Null Sample[/b] with gauntlet weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed relic sync errors.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed blue screen on Continue.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed enemy teleportation anomalies.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed relic "Ark Reactor" not converting Hearts properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed boss transformation logic errors.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed hotkey issues in bar evolution interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed progression blocks in certain rooms (Arcade Room).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed occasional XUAN skill failures.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed NIRVANA error when switching weapons during sound ring activation.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Debt not clearing after maxing Smiley Privilege  (Coin suit).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed attack anomalies during weapon swaps.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed YOKO anomalies when hit during Hatchmon absorption.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed unresponsive evolution interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed duplicate Hatchmon bug after Continue with Dr. Blue items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bombs detonating immediately on barriers (though, this one WAS funny for friends if you’re playing multiplayer).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed barrier items (e.g., Hybrid Doctrine, Microphone) detonating Bouncing Bettys.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Spinal Fluid bug after Continue.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed "HORUX" Magic Eyes not auto-targeting enemies.[/p][/*][/list][p] Veewo Games[/p]

notes.title: Update Note 8.12
notes.notes: [h1]August 12 Update Notice[/h1][p]Note: Updating may cause data errors when continuing the game. Please complete your current game session before updating.[/p][h1]Default Branch Update[/h1][hr][/hr][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where no pop-up appeared when Steam initialization failed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the number of school items was not restored after reconnection, and an error occurred in the player's flight status settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Abyss entry count for the client player was not effective.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where interaction with the [b]ERIS[/b] portal was not possible.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a phantom error that occurred when continuing the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a room error related to [b]HYPERION[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with incorrect initial drops for the Psychedelic Butterfly.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h1]Beta Branch Update[/h1][hr][/hr][h1]Major Update [b]\[ Fire Support ][/b] Now in Beta Branch[/h1][p][/p][h2]Update Summary[/h2][list][*][p][b]Blackdog Patch System:[/b] Players will receive a Black Dog Patch (item bundle) after each defeat to help Agents dominate the Abyss.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Comprehensive Weapon Adjustments and Optimization:[/b] Optimized mechanics and feel of numerous weapons, reworked some weapons, and adjusted all weapon values according to the new damage mechanics. (Continuous optimization in progress)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Weapon Visual Effects Optimization:[/b] Enhanced enemy bullet visibility and reduced player attack effects. (Continuous optimization in progress)[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Items:[/b] New batch of attack speed, range, and projectile items.[/p][/*][*][p][b]High-Definition Weapon Artwork Update[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]This update is currently in testing. We welcome everyone to experience it and provide feedback. We will continue to optimize and adjust based on the situation.[/p][p][/p][h2]Key Points of Weapon Optimization and Adjustments[/h2][p]Adjusted the underlying damage mechanics and added damage bonuses for each resource to their respective weapon types. Most weapons have undergone damage adjustments to adapt to the new version's damage configuration.[/p][p][b]VOLTEDGE[/b] [/p][p]Mechanism adjustment: Charge time no longer continuously decreases, but damage increases with each slash.[/p][p][b]VAJRA[/b] [/p][p]Significantly reduced the cooldown time of the messenger. The messenger's attack range now scales with damage growth.[/p][p][b]RAGNAROK[/b] [/p][p]Optimized charge time and reduced the difficulty of retrieving the axe. Increased fire gauntlet attack speed and damage.[/p][p][b]AVALANCHE[/b][/p][p]Fixed the error of dealing damage twice, shortened weapon charge time.[/p][p][b]OBLIVION[/b] [/p][p]Shortened charge time and added enemy penetration effect.[/p][p][b]CATALYST[/b] [/p][p]New mechanism: Enemies will instantly explode when marked layers exceed 9.[/p][p][b]COGDRIVE[/b] [/p][p]Significantly shortened all charge times. Fixed the bug where damage could be taken during stage 3 charge dash attack.[/p][p][b]WILDSHIFT[/b] [/p][p]Fixed the error where weapons weren't affected by egg quantity bonuses. Significantly increased mark duration.[/p][p][b]RED WIDOW[/b] [/p][p]New mechanism: The more eggs, the longer the reload time window.[/p][p][b]LOONG[/b] [/p][p]Optimized dragon behavior, now easier for players to control.[/p][p][b]JADEWEAVE[/b] [/p][p]Optimized artifact behavior, fixed the issue where artifacts wouldn't attack enemies.[/p][p][b]ZANSHIN[/b] [/p][p]Fixed the error where damage could be taken during dash attacks.[/p][p][b]FLUORESCENT[/b] [/p][p]Increased weapon damage and attack speed.[/p][p][b]JINGU BANG[/b] [/p][p]Fixed the error where spell damage wouldn't scale. Increased staff spinning range.[/p][p][b]PULSEARC[/b] [/p][p]Fixed damage loss error. Optimized lightning strike trigger mechanism, fixed lightning tracking logic error.[/p][p][b]EUPHONY[/b] [/p][p]Significantly increased sonic wave range, increased weapon attack speed. Removed combo mechanism.[/p][p][b]NIRVANA[/b] [/p][p]Mechanism optimization: Not attacking no longer breaks combo. Significantly increased sonic wave range and damage.[/p][p][b]SWEETALK[/b] [/p][p]Weapon attack changed to soft laser. Super Hatchmon now generates additional tracking bullets.[/p][p][b]TOPSPIN[/b] [/p][p]Fixed the error where tennis balls could be lost.[/p][p][b]YOKO[/b] [/p][p]Increased Hatchmon absorption speed.[/p][p][b]SUNDER[/b] [/p][p]Adjusted to Key faction weapon. Fixed critical chance error issue.[/p][p][b]ASCEND[/b] [/p][p]Increased Wisp absorption speed, improved spirit sword damage and flight speed.[/p][p][b]PURGE[/b] [/p][p]Fixed the error where tracking bullets couldn't deal multi-hit damage. Increased Wisp absorption speed.[/p][p][b]CACKLE[/b] [/p][p]Increased sonic ring speed and damage, increased Wisp absorption speed.[/p][p][b]VERDICT[/b] [/p][p]Increased weapon range. notes.title: PATCH NOTES: 8.01
notes.notes:
Hey Agents! We’re back again after the weekend and we’ve been working on getting come bug fixes and optimisations into the Abyss! It’s our first update in August, but it’s the first of August to cut us some slack, right?

A good number of changes in both Default and Beta Branch, and as usual if you do head into the Beta Branch, keep the bug reports coming – but please do bear in mind that this is the least stable branch (or the darkest timeline, whichever way you want to look at it).

Anyway. I’ve been nerding out enough for all of us. This is what’s hitting you today. In the spirit of Columbo – just one more thing (ask your parents if this goes over your head) – Updating may cause errors for the “continue game” function, so if possible, finish your run before updating.

[hr][/hr][h2]Default Branch Updates [/h2][h3]Bug Fixes [/h3][list][*] Fixed an issue related to backup saves[*] Fixed an issue where players wouldn’t enter the Busy state when collecting souls (if you were overlapping a portal)[*] Fixed the duplicate Cypher coin drops[*] Fixed incorrect save data preventing mission completion (we haven’t yet found a patch which can fix skill issues preventing mission completion so I am out of luck)[*] Fixed abnormal bullet effects from plugins[*] Fixed Psychedelic token drops on level 7 and above[*] Fixed non-host character companions (Hatchmons, Drones et al.) which weren’t attacking monsters[*] Fixed an issue where purchasing items in the Shop failed when carrying the Festival Red Envelope artifact[*] Fixed an issue where switching between controller / keyboard during QTE prompts in game rooms caused the QTE interface to freeze (and not in like a “Robot on the dancefloor” cool type of freeze, that would be sick)[*] Fixed an issue where repeatedly clicking continue on the settlement screen would cause Bar characters to disappear (we honestly don’t know where they went to but they are back now and they wouldn’t tell us what happened)[*] Fixed bugs related to the Dawn system[/list][h3]Adjustments and Optimisation [/h3][list][*] Optimised controller operation (auto aim now prioritises enemies which you can actually hit – which might be useful)[*] Improved Busy state detection based on actual player status rather than the UI status (or a finger-in-the-wind rough guess which works more often than you’d expect)[*] Optimised monster activation detection to prevent aiming at inactive monsters (how could you)[*] Improved Monster spawning mechanics[/list][hr][/hr][h2]Beta Branch Updates [/h2][h3]Additions [/h3][list] [*] Added a new backup save system[/list][h3]Bug Fixes [/h3][list][*] Fixed an issue related to backup saves (yup. Here, too!)[*] Fixed an issue where players wouldn’t enter the Busy state when collecting souls (if you were overlapping a portal)[*] Fixed duplicated Encrypt coin drops[*] Fixed incorrect damage calculation for JINGU BANG’s spell[*] Fixed potential duplication or collection failure issues with Saya’s weapons[*] Fixed incorrect save data preventing mission completion (just pretend we did a hilarious but original joke for this note, as well as the one in the Default Branch)[*]  Fixed JADEWEAVE focus shaking after combat (gave it a hot mug of sweet tea)[*]  Fixed abnormal bullet effects from plugins[*] Fixed non-host character companions (Hatchmons, Drones et al.) which weren’t attacking monsters[*] Fixed an issue where picking up Relics caused interaction abnormalities[*] Fixed an issue with abnormal item drop positions in Pain rooms (to be fair if you are going into Pain rooms you might just be looking for punishment anyway)[*] Fixed an issue with incorrect spawn positions for enemies related to Faith elements and Crystals[*] Fixed an issue where shop weapon levels would not scale with floor progression (because apparently you don’t like a challenge)[/list][h3]Adjustments and Optimisation [/h3][list][*] Improved the Hatchmon animation synchronisation in multiplayer[*] Reworked the Wild Hatchmon system for an improved experience[*] Improved backup state functionality (which now support swapping between backup and current saves)[*] Enhanced Critical Hit level change events and UI display[*] Improved player Busy state detection[/list][h3]Art and Localisation [/h3][list][*] Multi-lingual text update [/list] [hr][/hr][h3]Beta Branch Shenanigans [/h3]As ever, a quick reminder that if you’d like faster access to fixes, additions, improvements and other improvements, you can join the Beta Branch. To do this, just select it as your option by heading over to: [list][*] Library – Right click Neon Abyss 2 – Properties – Betas[/list] And selecting the Beta Branch from the drop-down menu.

Bear in mind, Agents, you will only be able to play multiplayer with folks on the same Branch as you, and the Beta Branch (as the name implies) is a testing platform meaning likelihood or more disruption.

notes.title: Update 7.29 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey Agents! We're back once again for another daily patch. As we plaster the walls of the Abyss with changes, we wanted to send another thank you for the tireless efforts that you've been putting in yourselves. You've left some incredible feedback so far, and the team here are working to get as much of it into the Abyss as possible.

We can't get to everything straight away, but the team has been working to make sure we're answering the constructive feedback in-game, and not just here with words. We're got a light touch on the Default branch today, but we've also moved a good number of bug fixes over into the Beta branch for testing. A fair amount of this focus has been directed towards the (multiple, sorry) issues related to the "Continue Game" feature, and networking connectivity.

We hope you'll continue to live, laugh, level your way through the Abyss. Here's what's been deployed in today's patch.[hr][/hr][h2]Default Branch Update[/h2][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]Continue Game[/b] feature would reset badge levels to 1.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues related to picking up blank badges and badge upgrades.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h1]Beta Branch Update[/h1][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with the "Continue Game" feature where the level of [b]Foundry Badges[/b] was incorrect and set effects would grant rewards repeatedly. (you probably liked that, but we're still taking it away)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where James' inventory was incorrect after continuing a game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where weapon badge levels were not correctly synced when continuing a game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where force-quitting the game with a full Faith bar could cause an abnormal Faith status after continuing the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where gambling machines would still incorrectly deduct money.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where purchasing items from the shop would fail when carrying the "Festival Red Packet" relic.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the QTE UI would freeze if the input device (keyboard/controller) was switched while the QTE prompt was on screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an error in the shield acquisition order of the Dawn System.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where rapidly clicking the "Continue" button on the results screen could cause the [b]character to disappear[/b] after returning to the bar. (wouldn't be the first time I'd ghosted my friends at the bar)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in multiplayer mode where the loading screen would get stuck if a teammate disconnected while entering the next level.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the flying ability would be lost after quickly entering and leaving a shop room.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed other potential issues that could cause game errors, improving overall stability.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Optimizations & Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p]Added a network region system. Players will now connect to corresponding servers based on their geographical location (Asia, Europe, Americas) for a more stable online experience. Cross-region matchmaking will not be available.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr]
So that's all we're deploying today, but we hope you continue to have a great time in the Abyss. "Oh, but how do I join the Beta Branch", you ask? well I'm GLAD you asked because I've already typed it and it would be a shame to waste it.
[h2]How to Switch to the Beta Branch:[/h2][list][*][p]Right-click "Neon Abyss" in your game library and select "Properties"[/p][/*][*][p]Under the "Beta" tab, select "beta - For testing" (Note: The Beta branch currently only supports Windows. We will update the stable version to other platforms as soon as testing is complete.)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 7.24 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey Agents! We’re back once again (sadly without the Renegade Master) for another update with 7.24 now live. Another huge thank you for all of the feedback you continue to deliver, it really does make a huge difference.

A slightly smaller update today, but an important one. The Beta Branch update for 7.24 now includes mid-game saving in single player. This is in testing (and thus the Beta Branch) and we hope to have it deployed for all Agents soon™, with progress going really well.

But enough of my waffle, what have we changed in the Abyss for update 7.24 – well I’m about to tell you so, stay a while, and listen.

[h2]Default Branch Updates [/h2][h3]Bug Fixes [/h3][list][*] Fixed an issue with weapon skins not loading correctly[*] Rounded up the SUNBLOOM Hatchmon and made sure it understands that it has to show up when a player has the weapon equipped[/list][h3]Adjustments and Optimisation [/h3][list][*] Optimised the in-game data collection system (boring for you, we know, but it will allow us to better monitor game stability)[/list][h3]UI and Localisation [/h3][list][*] Updated multi-lingual translations (again. Don’t even).[*] Fixed a "\#value" error with cosmetic descriptions within multi-lingual environments[/list]
[h2]Beta Branch Updates [/h2]As ever we have our separate Beta Branch update, which today has a really important addition. If you'd like to play in the Beta Branch head to:[list][*]Library – Right click Neon Abyss 2 – Properties – Betas[/list]And selecting the Beta Branch from the drop-down menu. There’s no password, but bear in mind that the Beta Branch is for more frequent and less tested updates, and will likely be less stable than the default branch.

[h3]Additions [/h3][list][*] Added mid-game saving and a “Continue Game” option for the single-player experience (just like you asked for!). When continuing, players will start from the initial landing room for the last floor you entered.[/list][h3]Bug Fixes [/h3][list][*] Fixed abnormal synchronisation issues with item locations within co-op[*] Fixed an issue where characters could get stuck in the aiming animation due to repeated weapon effects in co-op [/list][h3]Balance Adjustments [/h3][list][*] Increased Xuan’s “grazing range” (how close you have to get for his power to activate), increased the charge limit to 5 and expanded the range of his active skill[*] Still have not found a good marriage partner for Xuan but it’s something we’re working on. Let us know if you’d like to be in the running.[/list][h3]Adjustments and Optimisation [/h3][list][*] Optimised stuttering issues when entering and exiting rooms[*] Optimised UI effects when unlocking achievements[*] Optimised lighting effects for SKYREND[*] Optimised UI effects on the Reward Collection screen[/list]
[h2]More Thanks From Us! [/h2]That’s it. Once again. That’s all we have for you today, but we’ll be back again soon (maybe). Your feedback continues to make an impact on the Abyss. Now if only your weapons were making an impact on the enemy... Get on with it! 

As ever you can get through to us using (in order of preference / ease)
[olist]
[*] The in-game F3 prompt which will take you straight to our dedicated area
[*] The bug forum in the [url=https://discord.gg/hsANxzP]official Veewo Discord[/url]
[*] The Steam forums[/olist]Please do continue to let us know how you feel, and we’ll continue bringing you updates, tweaks, fresh content and (if you’re up for it) chaos in the Abyss.

notes.title: Update 7.23 Patch Notes

Well, Agents. It’s nearly a week since we went live with Neon Abyss 2 and we have yet another update which hopes to tweak, balance, change and apply a fresh coat of glow in the dark paint on the walls of the Abyss.

notes.title: Patch Notes 7.21
notes.notes:
Hey Agents. Another day and another update for the Abyss.

We’ve been making progress against a lot of the things you’ve been reporting so far, and the first thing we wanted to do today was send a continued thank you for taking the time to come and leave feedback – both constructive and positive. It’s really important for Neon Abyss 2’s continued evolution, and we can’t thank you enough.

There are a few of your pressing issues which we’ve taken steps to fix in 7.21 which have gone live in the default branch. We also wanted to give a reminder that if you’d like to test faster fixes (but maybe a little more disruptive environment) we also have the Beta Branch available!
So, let’s get to it. What’s been changed in the Abyss in 7.21? 
[h1]Default Branch Updates [/h1]
[h2]Bug Fixes [/h2]
[list][*] The Error Recovery button now also fixes weapon jamming (being unable to fire)
[*] Removed some gremlins which were stopping players from unlocking Lucia
[*] Fixed the inaccurate cursor positioning during auto-aiming and manual aiming when using a game pad
[*] Fixed an error which caused triggering of the Faith effect while in the Safe Room
[*] Fixed the incorrect UI display for the charge bar
[*] Fixed a bug stopping the explosive barrel mission from being completed
[*] Fixed a but which would show Zero hours played when loading save files
[*] Fixed a freeze issue when customisation screens are open while jumping into the Abyss[/list]
[h2]Balance Adjustments [/h2]
[list][*] Reduced the health bonus of enemies in Multiplayer mode
[*] Reduced the health of enemies in Normal difficulty
[*] Increased damage for item – Manoeuvre Gear[/list]
[h2]Adjustments and Optimisation [/h2]
[list][*] Once players defeat a Boss, a new bullet-clearing mechanism will remove remaining projectiles
[*] Handling of the RAPTOR weapon has been optimised
[*] To help reduce clutter, the VAJRA weapon effect layer has been moved to behind the player
[*] Judgment of the Flight state has been made more stable[/list]
[h2]Art and Localisation [/h2]
[list]
[*] Roadmap updated in Japanese[/list]
[h1]Beta Branch Updates [/h1]

If you’re not already in the Beta branch, this IS available for all players who own Neon Abyss 2. The Beta Branch provides a staging environment for us to test bug fixes (and all of the other bits) a little faster, but bear in mind that this can cause a more disruptive environment. 

To access the Beta Branch head to your Steam library, right click Neon Abyss 2, Properties, Betas, and select Beta (no password required). IMPORTANT NOTE: Players in either branch will only be able to play multiplayer with Agents in the same branch.

[h2]Bug Fixes [/h2]
[list][*] Fixed an issue stopping players from pausing challenge rooms in single-player mode
[*] Fixed visual issues with character eyelids to avoid colour errors

notes.title: Release Date + Online Co-op Playtest
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello once more, Cybermyth Combatants![/h3]

We’ve just shared our new trailer for Neon Abyss 2, and we’re thrilled to announce our Early Access release date for July 17th.

[previewyoutube=1yPukqtloa4;full][/previewyoutube]

The doors to the upgraded Abyss 2.0 will be opening in July, allowing you to take part in Abyss combat using upgraded weaponry, new and evolving Hatchimons, our new Faith system and up-to four-player online co-op as well!

You can join up with friends or jump in with other Cybermyth Combatants worldwide to journey through the new halls of the Abyss 2.0. In addition, release into Early Access means that you’ll have the opportunity to help our development team as we progress towards full launch of the new Abyss, as well.

The upgraded Abyss 2.0 looks to evolve everything you loved about the original game. We’ve worked to keep the core of what made Neon Abyss special, while adding in new features and capabilities which are only possible through re-building and re-shaping of the Abyss.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341641/3e5da58e7d8356c7430f1302ed3198cb11c622c8.gif[/img]

But July’s Early Access release isn’t the only way you can get in touch with Neon Abyss 2. We are currently rolling out a two-player co-operative multiplayer playtest. In this new playtest, we’ll be asking Cybermyth Combatants to dive in with a friend (or find a partner in our official [url=https://discord.gg/hsANxzP]Discord[/url]) to experience what the upgraded Abyss has to offer.

Keep up to date by wishlisting on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2235200/Neon_Abyss_2/]Steam[/url], where you can also request access to our gated and limited multiplayer playtest which will roll out slowly. You can also follow over on [url= http://x.com/neonabyssgame]X (Twitter) [/url], join the official Discord and keep up to date on the official website.
